center_stop.note: Replace the ordinary H22 mounting screw with this spacer. The existing PCB mounting pad is backed by the base support. Set the insulating cap to the measured 0.2-0.4 mm unloaded gap; this is a local deflection stop, not a plate-stiffness qualification.

component_height_scope: New hardware and the full carrier. Already-safe component heights use the conservative carrier bounding rectangle; potential conflicts or missing height limits receive exact material checks. A1 retains its separate official-model and cooler checks.

switch_pin_space.scope: Cylinders at the PCB locating holes use the hole radius plus 0.2 mm. The steel and film openings are checked separately. These are available-space limits, not measured switch pins; width, alignment and full mechanism motion still need the exact switch.

notes: The insulator, clips and steel must be checked against the actual assembled keyboard before tightening.
Clinch installation needs the specified sheet hardness, thickness, hole size and press tooling; the CAD does not qualify the installation.
The spacer uses the existing H22 mounting hole and backed PCB pad. The cap is a local deflection stop, not proof of overall keyboard stiffness.
Root screws clamp the brackets to the case bosses. These are not qualified sliding joints for thermal expansion.
Switch projection is not known. The reported limits must exceed the measured pins and mechanism movement before making the carrier.
The metal carrier, case bonding and liner wear need electrical-isolation checks. No battery return-domain connection or PCB change is made here.
